title: Miniatures (2009)
summary: Miniatures - also known as 3D Miniatures - is a line of collectible Titan minifigures and Amulets based on Season 1 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. The line was originally distributed by Tridimensional in Italy in individual blind bags and sold at Italian newsagents. It was subsequently distributed in other European countries by Panini and by Upper Deck in the UK and US. The Amulet models could be worn as necklaces, and could also act as display stands for their corresponding Titan.

sections.heading: Release
sections.wikitext:
The first wave of the Miniatures line was released in Italy in February 2009 and consisted of [[Draco-Titans]] and [[Krono-Titans]], packaged in blind bags. Each blind bag came with a corresponding playing card as part of a game that the collectors could play. A second wave of blind bags, consisting of [[Litho-Titans]] and [[Yama-Titans]], was released in Italy September 2009. 

In 2010, a selection of 16 Miniatures from the first wave were released in the UK and US by [[Upper Deck]]. The figures were packaged in blister packs of four, with one figure remaining a mystery. The UK 4-packs did not contain the Tridimensional cards with the figures, possibly to avoid confusion with Upper Deck's ''[[Huntik Trading Card Game]]''. 

In 2011, the line was succeeded by [[Miniatures (2011)|another range of minifigures]] based on [[Season 2]] of the show, this time manufactured and distributed by [[Giochi Preziosi]], the new toy master for the series. These were the same size and fully compatible with the original range.

full_text:
Miniatures - also known as 3D Miniatures - is a line of collectible Titan minifigures and Amulets based on Season 1 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. The line was originally distributed by Tridimensional in Italy in individual blind bags and sold at Italian newsagents. It was subsequently distributed in other European countries by Panini and by Upper Deck in the UK and US. The Amulet models could be worn as necklaces, and could also act as display stands for their corresponding Titan.

Release

The first wave of the Miniatures line was released in Italy in February 2009 and consisted of Draco-Titans and Krono-Titans, packaged in blind bags. Each blind bag came with a corresponding playing card as part of a game that the collectors could play. A second wave of blind bags, consisting of Litho-Titans and Yama-Titans, was released in Italy September 2009.

In 2010, a selection of 16 Miniatures from the first wave were released in the UK and US by Upper Deck. The figures were packaged in blister packs of four, with one figure remaining a mystery. The UK 4-packs did not contain the Tridimensional cards with the figures, possibly to avoid confusion with Upper Deck's Huntik Trading Card Game.

In 2011, the line was succeeded by another range of minifigures based on Season 2 of the show, this time manufactured and distributed by Giochi Preziosi, the new toy master for the series. These were the same size and fully compatible with the original range.
